For Petitioner : Mr. J.Mohamed I  For Respondents : Mr.K.Balasubram  Special Governme  ORDER
This Writ Petition is filed challenging the impugned order passed by the third respondent dated 05.11.2025.

The impugned order was passed under Section 32(3) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 r/w Rule 2.1.8(4) of the Food Safety and Standard (Food Business Licensing and Registration) Regulations, 2011, wherein the licence issued to the petitioner is temporarily suspended.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that even though the appellate remedy is available, in many cases, this Court has entertained and revoked the order of suspension.

Therefore,
the petitioner has approached this Court.

3. The learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis (
Uploaded on: 08/01/2026 12:37:54 pm ) submits that no concession can be given to the petitioner,
since the petitioner is already involved in similar types of offences and he has nine previous cases.
Therefore, the petitioner may be directed to file an appeal before the Appellate Authority.
4. I have considered the submissions made by both sides and perused the records.
5. I find merits in the submission of the learned Special Government Pleader for the respondents, as the petitioner has been involved in nine previous cases.

When the appeal remedy is available to the petitioner in terms of Rule 5.2.12 of the Food Safety and Standard (Food Business Licensing and Registration) Regulations, 2011, it would be appropriate for the petitioner to file statutory appeal and therefore, this Court is not inclined to entertain this case.
6.
